== Build notes (October 2026) ==

Built from <code>SealedLeagueProduct.java</code>, <code>SealedLeagueType.java</code>, <code>NewSealedLeagueData.java</code>, the pack and deck classes, <code>FixedPackBox.java</code>, <code>CollectionRequestHandler.java</code> and the Enhanced Jabba's Palace selection pack file at billbisco/swccg-gemp commit ec48dc19. These are compared with the Players Committee files at commit 5e26dd19. Card names come from the swccg-card-json card data, matched by GEMP card id. Each card link was checked against the card_uid on the wiki page. Cards that share a title, such as the Premiere and Coruscant Tatooine systems, link to the right set. The league type <code>hoth_dagobah_cc_sealed</code> has no product list in the product file. Relevant commits: 12cbfa1d (pull request 234), 8126b102 (pull request 254) and 6231e2f4 (pull request 255).
